sharedStyle.headline: Finding-led, concise, normally no more than two lines; rewrite rather than shrink when it overruns.
sharedStyle.containers: Avoid ornamental cards/boxes; use whitespace and fine rules for structure.
sharedStyle.colour: Mostly neutral marks. Pulse accent is stable; red means deterioration/risk, not Northstar identity; amber may indicate partial recovery.
sharedStyle.notes: Metric, universe, weighting and period remain readable and adjacent when they materially affect interpretation.
sharedStyle.numberFormatting: Distinguish %, percentage-point change and NPS points; use consistent rounding and derive changes from unrounded values.
sharedStyle.accessibility: Do not rely on colour alone for wave or semantic distinctions; reinforce with labels/marker treatment.
